text:
Potsdam’s median asking rent stands at 14.55 €/m², up 8.0 % year‑on‑year and 30.2 % over the past five years, placing the city seventh among the 37 most expensive German markets. The 60 m² typical apartment costs about 873 € per month, with a rent‑burden of 19.2 % for two residents, while listings spend an average of 22 days on the market and 40 % are let within a week, underscoring a tight market and a low vacancy rate of 1.3 %.

Affordability is pressured: asking rents exceed existing rents (7.85 €/m²) by 85 %, reflecting a premium that outpaces income growth. Population growth of 5.4 % over five years adds demand, while mortgage rates sit at 4.09 %.

The model‑based forecast predicts the median asking rent to reach 15.35 €/m² in 12 months, within a range of 14.64 – 15.72 €/m², implying a further 5.5 % rise.
